//MoonBasin: Feature 30, the Moon Realm's door (plan section 30, pack Prompt 43). A CardType 2 the player raises BESIDE vanilla's Moon Stone shrine (SpiritShrine_Moon_MoonStone, edf06b9a40876314f99f63e58a23d8d0; its blueprint hw_bp_moon_basin is location-locked to a board holding that shrine, so the shrine card itself is never edited). One action, 'Step into the Moonlight': offered at night (vanilla IsNight 413a4f94cfbfb8d4897c9dbf9dfbd49a at 1) under a full moon (vanilla MoonShape b9eb12da7bd636844808414c9748f879 at 4, as the fairy ring reads it; a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER), no time cost (like the ring, so no wild encounter can interrupt the step), and it drops only the instanced CardType 4 hwenvmoonrealm. UniqueOnBoard: one basin to a shrine. The way back is the realm's own exit card hw_moon_exit.

CardDescription.DefaultText: A shallow stone basin set beside the Moon Stone and filled with still water. On a full-moon night the moon lies in it as if the water were a door. Step into the moonlight and you may find the Moon Realm; you cannot stay long.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: On a full-moon night, step into the basin's moonlight and through it, into the Moon Realm. You can stay a few hours at most: step back through whenever you like, and when the moonlight runs out the pool sends you home to this shrine.
